title: Dasher Analytics Event Schema v1
description: Published openly at https://github.com/dasher-project/Dasher-Windows. If it's not in this schema, it's not collected. All Dasher frontends (Windows, Apple, GTK) share the same PostHog project — events are distinguished by the default properties below.

default_properties.description: Automatically appended to every event from every frontend

input_method_changed.note: Not emitted by Dasher-GTK as of 0.2.2; kept here because this schema is shared across frontends.

analytics_id_reset.description: User reset their anonymous analytics ID

crash.description: Uncaught C++ exception or fatal signal (SIGSEGV/SIGABRT/SIGILL), reported on the launch after the crash.

stack_trace.note: PII-scrubbed; may contain file paths but not user text. Empty for native signals, which are captured async-signal-safe.

crash.note: Dasher-GTK transmits this as a PostHog `$exception` event (Error Tracking), not a custom event named `crash`.

explicitly_not_collected: User name, email, or account info
